meta.title: Fly Colosseum
meta.description: Season after season, Trader Flies fight for a $FLYAI pot. Every fight is played by real fly brains from public stats, and every result can be checked. Provably fair.

head.title: Fly Colosseum
head.sub: Trader Flies fight for a pot of $FLYAI. Stats come from a fly's traits by public tables, every fight is played by two real fly brains, and nothing else decides who wins.

hero.leadOpen: Registration is open. Pick your fighters and pay the entry before the clock hits zero: nobody can enter after the start.
hero.leadRunning: The season has started. The server plays every fight on its own with the fly brains, and the whole bracket shows at once when the last one is done.
hero.leadDone: The season is over. Watch any fight from the bracket, check it yourself, and winners claim their prize.
hero.leadVoid: Not enough flies entered, so the season was called off and everyone was paid back.

t.closed: The colosseum is closed for now.

terms.title: Before your first real entry
terms.t1: You pay with real $FLYAI from your balance. You can lose it all.
terms.t2: The season is decided by public stats and real fly brains; nobody can change a result, and the server seed is revealed at the end so you can check every fight.
terms.t3: Prizes go to your balance when you claim them. Withdrawals are sent by hand and can take a day.
terms.t4: This may be illegal where you live. It's your responsibility to follow your local laws.
terms.accept: I accept the terms (the same terms as Fly Roulette)

how.title: How a fight works
how.h1: Stats from traits, nothing hidden. Every Trader Fly gets Power, Guard, Vitality and Fury from its traits by the tables below.
how.h2: Ten rounds. Each round both flies' real brains smell the rival and see it charge. We count charge spikes and escape spikes.
how.h3: Damage. hit = charge x 2 x (1 + 0.25% x Power) x (1 + 0.5% x Fury while under half HP). block = escape x 0.8 x (1 + 0.6% x Guard). Damage = hit minus the rival's block. HP = 200 + Vitality.
how.h4: Single elimination. Fights end on a knockout or after ten rounds on points. The two beaten semi-finalists fight for 3rd.
how.h5: Provably fair. The server commits to its seed when registration opens, every entry brings its own seed, and the seed is revealed at the end: Verify replays a fight in your browser.
how.h6: The pot. Every entry and potion goes in. The house fee comes out; the rest is 60% / 25% / 15% for the top three. Too few flies: everything is refunded.
how.tColor: Colorway (4 points, to the stat its number picks)

shop.title: Shop
shop.potionsText: Add points to a fly, up to {max} per fly and season. Everyone sees them. Buy a potion for one season when you enter a fly (or add it to a fly already in until the clock hits zero), or buy it for good.
shop.aurasText: A glow around the fly in the ring and on its card, looks only, no stats. Buy one once and it is the fly's for good: if the fly is sold, the aura goes to its new owner. Wear it or take it off whenever you like, in any season.
shop.where: Buy on a fly's card in Your squad, from your $FLYAI balance.
shop.forGoodText: A potion for good belongs to the fly: it is free to add to any season, and it stays with the fly and moves to its new owner if it is sold. You can carry up to 2 into a season.
